_comment: Config for `mimo-code` — opencode driven by the mimo endpoint. Baked into
the image at /opt/claude-desk/ and pointed at by OPENCODE_CONFIG, never
under /home/claude: docker seeds a named volume only while it is empty, so
a file placed in the home volume never reaches an already-deployed desk.
{env:...} is opencode's own substitution — the key stays in .env.
permission: everything allowed, same bargain as `claude
--dangerously-skip-permissions` here. The container is the cage (no docker
socket, /work is the only mount from outside) and a per-tool tap on a phone
reasoning_effort=low is not a saving, it is the working setting: the
default burned 10,457 tokens/161s against 3,796/79s for a worse answer, and
mimo's wall time tracks the tokens it thinks (~30 tok/s).
limit.output is generous on purpose — a small cap is spent on thinking
first and the turn comes back empty (shared/mimo.py).
